title: Hamilton implementer result
description: The exact JSON an implementer worker returns as its final message (PARALLEL.md §3). Passed to `codex exec --output-schema` so the CLI enforces the contract.

task.description: The <task-id> this worker was dispatched for.

role.description: The role id, e.g. backend-developer or fullstack-developer#2.

artifacts.description: Project-relative paths of deliverables written (may be non-empty even when blocked).

to.description: Receiving role for handoff; null otherwise.

events.description: Ledger entries for the orchestrator (the single writer) to serialize — the worker never writes events.jsonl itself.

blocked_reason.description: Populated only when status is blocked.
